steps: Open your first Wescom Checking Account by 12/31/2026 using promotional code WELCOME (must be 18+ with a valid US Tax Identification Number)
Set up direct deposit and receive a minimum $500 direct deposit into the Wescom account for two consecutive months during the New Member Period (the first three full calendar months after joining)
$200 bonus is deposited to the new Wescom Checking Account the first week of the month after all qualifications are met
catches: New member defined as a person who has never been a primary owner of an account with Wescom - former members excluded
Requires real $500+ direct deposits for two consecutive months within the New Member Period
Not valid with any other offer; membership eligibility required (Wescom is a Southern California credit union)

Subject to change or end without notice

timing: Two consecutive $500+ direct deposits due within the New Member Period (first three full calendar months after joining); $200 deposited the first week of the month after all qualifications are met.
